name: TCL 43S5K / 32V5C (G13, G13_2K_GB, MediaTek MT9221/MT5867, 1 GB), India; also a G13 unit from Brazil, a 40" V5C on AU13, a 32V51C from Indonesia (AU13), a second AU10 unit and a 50S5K from Colombia (AU11)
warnings: The launcher half now works on the AU13 unit too, confirming it was never an AU13-specific regression: the first two attempts skipped Batch 3 (setupwraith stayed enabled) and both landed on its RecoveryActivity, exactly as this list's own Batch 3 note predicts.
Volume keys never reach any accessibility service's onKeyEvent on this unit, so no app-side remap or synthesized repeat can restore ramping without root.
Keep it enabled: a related MediaTek build repeatedly crashed the service after that provider was removed (#2138).

Earlier 43S5K, AU07 and AU13 reports disabled it without a reported crash; those historical runs do not establish that removing this provider is safe on every G13 build after a reboot.  com.tcl.ttvs on this firmware is BOTH TCL's analytics (bi.core.BIService, identifier, trackdata) AND TCL's firmware/app updater (versionUpdateApp.core.SystemUpdateService).
The two Brazilian partner apps at the end were disabled too; they stay commented here because the Indian units do not ship them.
